title: HelperSSHLeaseParams
description: One pooled reference to acquire for a resolved destination, so that the named probes have a connection to run on rather than one dial per command. It takes the same destination shape `probe` and `open` take — resolved host, port, user and identity — because alias resolution, ~/.ssh/config merging and the credential's authorization against an endpoint stay in the coordinator, which is the party that reads the config and holds the binding. It is deliberately not a channel: nothing is opened on the connection here, and no bytes move.

destination.description: What to connect to and what to authenticate as.

acceptOnTrust.description: The coordinator's answer to 'may a host key this host has never presented be recorded', carried exactly as probe.params carries it: the helper may not decide that for itself, and the decision travels with the call that started the handshake. False is the ordinary value and produces the host-key-unknown refusal below.
